description: A single finished illustration intended to stand on its own.

character: Draw a character illustration of a sailor at sunset.
environment: Create an illustrated coastal environment after rain.
wallpaper: Make a wide desktop wallpaper of a calm ocean horizon.

prompt_guidance: State the subject, composition, lighting, and requested medium.
prohibited_content: Do not add unrequested text or watermarks.

subject_completeness.description: The requested subject is complete and recognizable.

style_consistency.description: The requested visual style is applied consistently.

detail_quality.description: Important requested details are clear and deliberate.
